When trying garlic, asking politely, and using reverse psychology didn't work, it became clear that machine learning is the only answer to banishing our unwanted guests.\n\n![](https://storage.googleapis.com/kaggle-media/competitions/kaggle/5708/media/halloween-660x.png)\n\nSo now the hour has come to put the data we’ve collected in your hands. We’ve managed to identify 371 of the ghastly creatures, but need your help to vanquish the rest. And only an accurate classification algorithm can thwart them.
